name: GitHub Release Packaging
purpose: Draft release notes, generate changelog deltas, and attach verified release assets.
inputs: Previous tag, target version, and SemVer rationale
Merged PRs, issue links, and changelog delta
Build, signing, asset, checksum, and SBOM matrix
outputs: Versioned release notes with grouped changelog and migration guidance
CI-built platform assets with SHA256SUMS and SBOM
Tag-to-commit proof and post-publish asset verification
stop_conditions: The tag, changelog, migration notes, assets, checksums, SBOM, and post-publish proof are complete
